verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents some event-driven automation. Conditional access policies revoke access automatically when a device falls out of compliance or a user leaves a trusted network, and HRIS-driven onboarding/offboarding workflows and identity lifecycle changes run with minimal manual intervention. These cover specific domains only, and the evidence shows no general user-defined rule engine for triggering arbitrary actions on events; broader automation relies on APIs or PowerShell scripting. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event-trigger/rule builder, event-driven webhooks or actions from Directory Insights events, detailed docs on defining custom trigger rules, independent hands-on corroboration.
